newsitem.title: USA: Time Warner unit tenders for $140 mln debt.
newsitem.headline: Time Warner unit tenders for $140 mln debt.

text.p: Time Warner Inc subsidiary, Summit Communications Group Inc said Thursday it will offer to purchase any and all of its $140 million outstanding 10.5 percent senior subordinated debentures due 2005.

The company said the tender offer will expire at 0000 EDT/0400 GMT August 26. It is conditioned on the receipt of certain consents from the holders of a majority of the principal amount of the debentures.
The principal purpose of the offer is to retire the debentures and to provide additional operating and financial flexibility said the company.
